mentions.name: OpenReturn
mentions.description: An open source agent and engine that calculates Federal and California taxes. It aims to act as an AI CPA, enabling very cheap tax estimates and planning, and is seeking contributors.
mentions.problem: Professional tax estimates and planning are expensive.
mentions.audience: U.S. taxpayers needing Federal and California tax estimates and planning
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on an open source agent and engine that can calculate your Federal and California taxes. My goal is to build an AI system that can act as your CPA, and hopefully allow you to do super cheap tax estimates and planning.
mentions.author: atcole
